assumptions.statement: The submitted SITE-001 polygon is the repository's maintainer-defined provisional overall-design boundary, not an official redline.
assumptions.impact: All coordinates and derived areas are suitable only for open-call design discussion and provisional checking; replace and rebuild when official geometry is supplied.

assumptions.statement: PROV-KEY-001/002/003 are rough rectangular study frames based on announced area, north-south order and public clues.
assumptions.impact: The three court concepts may be assessed as content but their exact siting, area and interfaces require official polygons.

assumptions.statement: GeoJSON exchange uses EPSG:4326 and all declared metric areas/lengths are independently recomputed in EPSG:4548.
assumptions.impact: The official project survey datum is still missing; professional use requires datum confirmation and a complete rebuild.

assumptions.statement: An official or cleared boundary update triggers regeneration of land use, buildings, routes, green/public space, constraints, phases, metrics, figures and drawings.
assumptions.impact: Selective coordinate replacement would break the evidence chain and is prohibited.

assumptions.statement: Five land-use polygons are a conceptual functional allocation cut from one provisional polygon with shared projected edges.
assumptions.impact: They demonstrate an exhaustive topology and design logic, not statutory zoning, ownership or development rights.

assumptions.statement: Official existing building footprints, use, age, height, ownership and retain/renovate/demolish surveys are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The three submitted footprints are reversible program envelopes only; no building or demolition decision is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, station boundaries, traffic counts, accessibility audit, parking, utilities and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Submitted lines are conceptual slow-mobility and feedback relationships, not road, rail, bridge, tunnel or construction alignments.

assumptions.statement: Official park, river, blue-line, flood, drainage, ecology and heritage-control GIS layers are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Green and public-space geometry is schematic and must be recalibrated through environmental, water, heritage and accessibility review.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, utilities, fire access and statutory controls are not public in the site package.
assumptions.impact: Exact development intensity and engineering feasibility remain unknown and are never presented as approved conditions.

assumptions.statement: Five human constituencies hold votes (use, community, innovation, professional operations and ecology); AI participates only as a non-voting observer.
assumptions.impact: AI cannot approve, deny, rank civic rights, promise safety or replace professional and public judgment.

assumptions.statement: The public contract requires no purchase, scan or profiling; even offline, each activated segment must provide a usable route to seating, drinking water, toilet access, charging, human help and static transit information.
assumptions.impact: This is an activation standard, not evidence that existing facilities already satisfy it; field audit, operator assignment, opening hours and accessibility testing are required.

assumptions.statement: AI is limited to aggregate service-status summaries, facility fault reporting and human-reviewed accessible-route updates.
assumptions.impact: Facial recognition, individual trajectory tracking, persistent personal profiles and automated risk scoring are prohibited; basic service must survive AI and network failure.

assumptions.statement: Every pilot must publish a Seat Pass covering purpose, responsible party, data retention, model failure, human checkpoint, non-AI equivalent, appeal/pause and expiry.
assumptions.impact: A scenario without all fields stays inactive; each pass needs pilot-specific legal, safety, privacy, accessibility and operational review.

assumptions.statement: 100% Seat Pass completeness, non-AI equivalence, human-handover drills and exit metadata are design targets, not measured baseline facts.
assumptions.impact: Operational performance remains unknown until pilots, operators, audit samples and public reporting exist.

assumptions.statement: P1/P2/P3 polygons are mutually exclusive primary-action envelopes for transparent area accounting.
assumptions.impact: They do not commit government schedule, funding, acquisition or construction; each stage can pause, revise, restore or retire.

assumptions.statement: No operator, budget, procurement route, implementation body or government commitment is assumed.
assumptions.impact: Every pilot requires a named accountable operator, expiry date, restoration/exit budget and public review before activation.

assumptions.statement: The official Architecture Engineering Design Document Depth Regulation (2016 edition) is not available in the repository.
assumptions.impact: It is treated only as a documented depth-reference gap and not as formal authority until a cleared official file is added.
